data.original_title: The Last Job on Mercer Street
data.overview: A carefully planned diamond heist collapses under suspicion that one crew member was an informant. Trapped in a warehouse, a handful of surviving thieves trade accusations as their alliances and tempers disintegrate.
data.tagline: The score went wrong. The blame starts now.
data.title: The Last Job on Mercer Street
